items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Gustav Wally... was in the show with me... and Cecile Sorel... she was the star of the show... the Casino de Paris, as I say, was Vive Paris with Cecile Sorel.

ctx.x: Yes. Now, I tell you what -- Gustav Wally, when I was in the Casino de Paris, I went in after Josephine -- Gustav Wally, who was the grandson of the King of Sweden, was in the show with me, called -- and Cecile Sorel, who was the woman, the Sarah Bernhardt of France -- she -- it was Vive Paris, the name of the show -- she was the star of the show.

And Gustav Wall was in this show, who was the grandson of the King of Sweden, and I was -- we were talking. I -- he was a dancer, but a lousy one, but he was very good. He was the sweetest thing in the world, Chris. And he would -- we'd get to talking. So he said to me -- I said -- he told me he was from the Scandinavian countries, you know, from up that way.
